Scald Puff.name: Scald Puff
Scald Puff.description: The user vents a sharp puff of hot vapor from the palm at a target within two strides, shorter than a Fire user's jet and carrying no open flame. It deals fire damage and forces the target to flinch back; held back, the user vents it cooler so the damp gust only stings their skin and makes them drop what they hold. In a cold room or dry air, its reach drops to arm's length. Strain: light.
